The behavior observed in the code matches the issue report's symptoms, indicating that missing escaping in this method is the likely root cause.

Title: Diagnosis
Details: The failing test `testUnion` in `JDOMModelTest` is asserting the XPath value of `/vendor[1]/contact[4] | /vendor[1]/contact[1]` to be "John". The current bug report describes a core union operation issue where the result nodes are not sorted according to document order. The bug report provides an example with a source document and an XPath expression (`string(/MAIN/B | /MAIN/A)`) that calculates incorrectly, resulting in an unexpected value of "b" instead of "a". This behavior aligns with the failure observed in the test case, where the expected value is "John", but the actual value is "b".

The issue is likely related to the sorting of result nodes in union operation within the XPath processing logic, causing incorrect values to be returned. To confirm the root cause, we should inspect the implementation of the union operation and how it handles sorting the result nodes according to document order.
